LanguageData.Binguin.label: binguin
LanguageData.Binguin.description: The binguin civilization, come from a world of bitter winter. Their "observation posts" are scattered across the world.
LanguageData.BinguinHostile.label: binguin Frostfang
LanguageData.BinguinHostile.description: A radical branch that split from the binguin mother civilization. They are no longer content to look up at the stars; they hold that nothing is finished until the whole frozen plain lies underfoot. Their gear and their tactics are exactly those of their kin—only they send no one to talk.
LanguageData.Binguin_PlayerColony.label: binguin
LanguageData.Binguin_PlayerColony.description: Binguin observers from a world of bitter winter. They have fallen here in escape pods, and will raise a new observation post on this unfamiliar rimworld.
LanguageData.Binguin.label: binguin
LanguageData.Binguin.description: The binguin, come from a world of winter.
